source: Yu et al. 2025, NASA NTRS 20250004626, Figure 1(b), Sections 2.2.1-2.2.2
scope: Source-based dimensional estimates derived from published figures, text context, and nominal resistance (1.4-1.5 ohm at 0.5 A). NOT as-built CAD dimensions. Exact values require direct measurement or author communication.
description: Inverted YSZ/Pt hollow-anode molten regolith electrolysis cell. YSZ tube acts as both solid electrolyte and structural anode body. Mo rod serves as central cathode. Pt mesh provides current collection on outside of YSZ.

cathode.notes: Solid molybdenum rod; inner radius null (solid). High melting point (2623 C), stable in reducing atmosphere.

wall.notes: Ionic conductor at MRE temperatures (~1600 C). Oxygen ions transported outward; oxygen gas evolved at external Pt interface.

anode.role: Current collector exterior to YSZ tube
anode.notes: Platinum mesh or foil. Stable in oxidizing atmosphere at high temperature. Collects current from electrochemical oxygen evolution at YSZ-Pt interface.

vessel.notes: Chemically stable at MRE temperatures. Electrically insulating. Contains regolith melt.

melt.notes: Principal oxide components: SiO2, Al2O3, CaO, MgO, FeO, TiO2. Ionic conductor in molten state. Oxygen source for electrolysis.

gas.role: Oxygen outlet plenum / gas collection region
gas.notes: Evolved at YSZ-Pt interface (anode). Collected and vented. Byproduct of lunar oxygen ISRU production.

one_hour_run.notes: Resistance drops slightly as cell reaches thermal equilibrium

twelve_hour_run.notes: Resistance drop over 12 h may indicate electrolyte conditioning or melt composition change

geometry_rationale.cathode_radius: Mo rod ~3 mm estimated from figure proportions; consistent with commercial Mo rod stock
geometry_rationale.ysz_wall_thickness: ~2 mm thick YSZ tube; thinner walls risk fracture, thicker walls increase ohmic resistance
geometry_rationale.active_height: ~25 mm estimated from charge/area context and tube proportions visible in Figure 1(b)
geometry_rationale.resistance_consistency: R = ln(ro/ri) / (2*pi*h*sigma) with YSZ conductivity ~2 S/m at 1600 C gives R ~ 1.3-1.7 ohm, consistent with published 1.44-1.54 ohm

limitations: All dimensions are estimates scaled from published figure; not validated against as-built hardware drawings
YSZ conductivity is temperature-dependent; constant-property model is a simplification
Resistance values include electrochemical interfacial contributions not captured by bulk geometry alone
Geometry varies between experimental runs and may differ from nominal configuration
This JSON is a reference for scenario setup, not a calibrated digital twin
